verdict.headline: Fed rules out 2026 rate cuts as US-Iran ceasefire collapses and oil surges
verdict.rationale_short: The dual-gate BUY regime survived a worst-case dual shock: Trump declared the US-Iran ceasefire 'over' mid-session (Brent +5.2% to $78), and FOMC minutes confirmed no rate cuts until Q2 2027 with Chair Warsh — for the first time since 2012 — withholding his dot plot entirely. The regime was saved by a single idiosyncratic positive: Beijing's H200 chip approval for Alibaba and ByteDance powered NVDA to $204.12, confirming Gate 3 ($200 close) for the first time. Post-close, BTC recovered from a session low near $61,500 to $62,465 — Gate 2 ($62,000 UTC midnight floor) intact by $465. FOMC split was 9 hike / 8 hold / 1 cut; September hike probability now at 68.8%. June CPI on July 14 is the next regime-defining binary. SKHY Nasdaq ADR prices tonight (July 9) — debut July 10.

bear_case: The dual-gate survived on the thinnest of margins — VIX 16.90 is 0.10 units below the 17 regime threshold, and SPX 7,482 is 22 points above the 7,460 floor. The FOMC minutes delivered the structural repricing that bears have been waiting for: not just no cuts, but a 68.8% hike probability with Chair Warsh declining to show his hand on the dot plot — the first time a sitting Fed Chair has withheld in over a decade. This is maximum policy uncertainty at the worst possible time. Simultaneously, the US-Iran ceasefire has officially collapsed; if Brent sustains above $80 (the next key level), Q3 inflation expectations rerate higher, which validates the hawks and potentially compresses the timeline to a hike. BTC's intraday breach of $62,000 to $61,537 — before recovering to $62,464 — signals the $62K floor is increasingly porous. A UTC midnight close below $62,000 on any session before June CPI triggers the mandatory $58,100 stop. The forward sequence is uncomfortable: SKHY pricing July 9 (any demand miss would ripple into chip complex sentiment), June CPI July 14 against a Brent-elevated backdrop, and NVDA's first Gate 3 confirmation with five more sessions required before the August 26 earnings. If VIX closes above 17 on any of those sessions, the regime reverts to BEARISH and the thesis is wrong.
